scoring_formula: faithfulness = 100 * max(0, (S + 0.5*P + 0*U - 1*C) / (S + P + U + C)); UNVERIFIABLE claims are excluded from the denominator and reported as (1 - evidence_coverage). Caps: any CONTRADICTED claim -> score <= 60; any UNSUPPORTED claim -> score <= 80; 'perfect' (100) only if every verifiable claim is SUPPORTED.

human_sentiment_check.interpretation: 37 of 117 one- and two-star reviews carry the human label 'positive', so the human labels disagree with the star ratings far more than the extraction does; this check is therefore inconclusive about extraction quality and the human labels themselves need review.
